annotations.title: Check how TikTok will treat a video before posting it

description: Reads the header of a video file at a public https URL (an upload's media_url works) and says what TikTok will do with it: codec and profile, width x height, fps, average bitrate (kbps), duration, HDR/10-bit, audio codec, and a verdict — keeps_quality (TikTok leaves it looking the same), recompressed (TikTok visibly re-encodes it: HEVC/AV1, HDR or 10-bit, above 1080x1920, above 30 fps, above 16 Mbps) or unknown (the header could not be read). advice lists what to change and message_for_user is one sentence with the export settings TikTok leaves almost untouched (1080x1920, H.264 High, 30 fps, 8-12 Mbps, AAC, SDR). Reads at most 768 KB of the file, nothing is published or changed. Up to 60 checks an hour per account.

url.description: The https link to the .mp4 or .mov file itself (not a share page).

name: check_video_quality
